text: Web3 based self sovereign identity gives individuals, and potentially AI systems themselves, control over their digital identities without a central authority, which in AI governance means AI entities can hold verifiable credentials.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, AI Governance Via Web3 Reputation System (2024). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=4941807

isBasedOn.name: AI Governance Via Web3 Reputation System

abstract: Web3-based self-sovereign identity (SSI) allows individuals—and potentially AI systems—to have control over their digital identities without relying on a central authority. In the context of AI governance, SSI ensures that AI entities have verifiable credentials

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: where self sovereign identity infrastructure is available to both humans and AI agents
